prediction.likelyOutcome: 7205 Telegraph is likely to prevail on liability for breach of the condominium instruments and on declaratory relief invalidating (or requiring remedy of) the 2015 reallocation, given the Association's own expert's admission that 12 spaces violates the zoning-required minimum and the undisclosed self-dealing by the two Phase I directors who voted. Damages, however, will turn heavily on which appraisal methodology the court credits, producing a wide realistic range, and will be partially offset by 7205 Telegraph's own exposure on unpaid post-2017 assessments, which is not separately quantifiable on this record.

outcome.description: After a bench trial the Fairfax County Circuit Court entered judgment for 7205 Telegraph on all four counts, awarding $481,434.84 in lost-rent contract damages, a further $6,296.70 for over-assessments, release of the association's liens, and $324,977.60 in attorney's fees and costs. A Court of Appeals panel affirmed on April 25, 2023; rehearing en banc was granted, and on December 19, 2023 the court lifted the stay and left the judgment affirmed.
outcome.finalNote: Affirmed, including after rehearing en banc.
